body:
on the back: “before sunday's rain, a cloying orchard smell in the weathered bundle after the livestock supplement test. my sister coughed all night. later, warning tape went up.”

I asked for the old page back after the new instructions arrived. They said it had been destroyed, but its corner was still in my pocket.

The person who was supposed to collect it had no time to stop. I did not put it back with the rest of the ordinary papers.
title: weathered bundle note — before sunday's rain
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a cloying orchard smell while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
